groups.activity: conservation at night, or fishing with bait
groups.meta: several capped days to Trusted from zero

rows.label: Visitor
rows.note: 22,000 standing; 25,000 cr, 10 Tear Azurite, 40 Pyrol, 60 Fish Scales

rows.label: Trusted
rows.note: 44,000 standing; 50,000 cr, 1 Cetus Wisp, 5 Maprico; unlocks gilding

conditions: The daily standing cap is the real time gate if you start from zero Ostron standing.
bonuses: Conservation is the fastest standing; Ivara's Sleep Arrow or Loki with subsumed Equinox Sleep get perfect captures, and learning the Kavat spawn spots caps the day in minutes.
Murkray, Norg, Cuthol and Glappid pay well per fish, and cutting extras covers Fish Scales.
Hand spare raw Azurite and Devar to Old Man Suumbaat for standing.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, a Grip and a Link

rows.label: Jai Link
rows.note: 1,000 standing; 5,000 cr, 10 Nistlepod, 20 Pyrotic Alloy, 2 Condroc Wing, 5 Khut-Khut Venom Sac

conditions: Mastery belongs to the Strike; the grip only decides Sword or Staff, so pick the cheapest.
A forged Zaw can't be taken apart; the parts are consumed.

groups.activity: night loop: mine every vein, smash containers, fish, lap the lakes for Wisps
groups.meta: refine at Old Man Suumbaat, Neutral

rows.label: Pyrotic Alloy
rows.note: 3 builds of 20 Pyrol, 200 Cryotic, 50 Rubedo; plus 20 more for the Jai link

rows.label: Iradite
rows.note: rock deposits in low-lying areas, loot containers

rows.label: Fish Scales
rows.note: cut any Plains fish at Fisher Hai-Luk

rows.label: Cetus Wisp
rows.note: 1 for Trusted, 2 to gild; water's edge, up to 5 at night

conditions: The Tear Azurite and Pyrotic Alloy refine blueprints cost 500 standing each from Old Man Suumbaat.
Pyrol is the sink: 60 for the Strike's alloy, 20 more alloy for the Jai link, and 40 raw for Visitor. Mine red veins every trip.
Cetus Wisps don't respawn until you leave and re-enter the Plains.
bonuses: A high-Strength Volt makes Konzu escort bounties much faster.

disclosures.title: Fish Scales count
disclosures.body: The research wiki read gives 25 Fish Scales for the Strike; the item data says 20. Bring 25 to be safe.

groups.activity: build, assemble, level, gild, level again

rows.label: Ooltha Strike
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 20 Iradite, 20 Fish Scales, 10 Tear Azurite, 60 Pyrotic Alloy, 1h

rows.label: level to 30, then gild at Hok
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp, 5,000 cr; resets to rank 0

conditions: A freshly forged Zaw earns no Mastery.
A second Ooltha Zaw with a different grip or link gives nothing more.
bonuses: Donate spare rank-30 Zaws to Hok for Ostron standing once this one is mastered.
